images.description: Architectural model representation; source dates vary. Violet indicates unresolved source versions. M3 upper form and crown silhouette, M4 maximum envelope and M5 developer proxy are approximate. Additional plan envelopes retain their individual height and placement limits. Recorded-construction views use separately dated stage evidence; cladding progress is not reproduced. Tree crown sizes and extra woodland canopy positions are illustrative. Recorded-construction landscaping uses conservative future-envelope crown clearances, not a dated tree-removal survey. Inland water levels are terrain-derived display estimates, not surveyed levels. Bridge road heights use dated elevation evidence and documented approach interpolation; they are not surveyed engineering profiles. Coloured transit routes use normal scene depth and follow approximate physical profiles; buildings, bridges and ground hide obstructed sections. They are not surveyed engineering alignments. Latest geometry remains unavailable for some projects. Read Model-guide.md and project register.
